passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to historical financial information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that are based upon current plans, expectations and beliefs that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth under Part I, Item 1A, “Risk Factors” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This Item generally discusses our results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. For a discussion of our results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, please refer to Part II, Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on February 26, 2025, and incorporated herein by reference. Overview We envision a world in which every digital interaction is amazing. By combining our leading communications capabilities with rich contextual data and AI, we provide the infrastructure for businesses of all sizes to revolutionize how they engage with their customers by delivering seamless, trusted, and personalized customer experiences at scale. We offer highly customizable communications APIs that enable developers to embed numerous forms of messaging, voice, email, and video interactions into their customer-facing applications, as well as software products that target specific engagement needs, including our digital engagement centers, marketing campaigns, and user authentication and identity solutions. This combination of flexible APIs and software solutions, together with our customer data capabilities, helps businesses of all sizes and across numerous industries to benefit from smarter and more streamlined engagement at every step of the customer journey, including reduced customer acquisition costs, lasting loyalty, and increased customer value. The value proposition of our offerings has become stronger and our products have become more strategic to our customers as businesses are increasingly prioritizing building more personalized and differentiated customer engagement experiences through digital channels. On January 1, 2025, we realigned our business unit structure into a functional support model under one organization. We believe that operating as one organization best positions us as we seek to deliver one trusted, smart and integrated platform that enables more personalized communications and engagements for customers. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Investing in our Class A common stock (“common stock”) involves a high degree of risk. A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before making a decision to invest in our common stock. The risks and uncertainties described below may not be the only ones we face. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment. Risk Factor Summary Our business operations are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including those outside of our control, that could cause our business, results of operations, and financial condition to be harmed, including risks regarding the following: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry • the impact of global economic and political conditions, including macroeconomic and political uncertainties; • fluctuations in our quarterly results and our ability to meet securities analysts’ and investors’ expectations; 10 Table of Contents • fluctuations in the levels of our customers’ usage of our platform; • our ability to attract new customers and increase usage of our products by existing customers effectively and in a cost-efficient manner; • our ability to develop new products and enhancements that achieve market acceptance and adapt to changing technology, regulations, and industry standards; • our ability to integrate our products with third-party products and ensure they operate effectively; • our ability to effectively manage our growth and strategic changes to our business; • our ability to compete effectively in intensely competitive and rapidly evolving markets; • our history of losses and uncertainty about our future profitability; • our ability to hire, integrate and retain highly skilled personnel; • our ability to maintain and enhance our brand and increase market awareness of our company and products; credit_strengths.text: Revenue has compounded steadily across the three-year trend while operating income swung from a loss to a modest profit, showing the platform is scaling toward profitability. Operating cash flow more than doubled over the same span, evidencing genuine cash generation rather than accounting earnings, which underpins debt-servicing capacity.

The balance sheet is liquid and conservatively financed: cash exceeds reported debt, net leverage is negligible, and the current ratio is far above the sector median. Interest coverage, while below the sector median, remains adequate given the net cash position and the minimal indicative financial risk profile.

key_risks.text: The risk-factor summary flags a history of losses and uncertainty about future profitability, alongside intense competition and rapid technological change. Operating margin remains thin relative to the sector median, so any pricing pressure, usage slowdown, or failed product transition could quickly erode the modest profitability achieved and pressure internal cash generation.

Debt is almost entirely long-term borrowings with no separately tagged short-term borrowings or commercial paper, and no maturity schedule was disclosed. Refinancing is therefore concentrated in a single bullet whose timing is opaque, while cash interest paid is the only interest-cost proxy available, limiting visibility into the true cost of that obligation.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers reported debt comfortably and dwarfs annual cash interest paid, so debt service is well supported by recurring cash generation. Net leverage is negligible and the indicative financial risk profile is minimal, giving substantial headroom against the sector median leverage level.

Liquidity is strong, with current assets covering current liabilities several times over and cash exceeding debt. However, capital expenditure is not disclosed, so free cash flow and its coverage of debt cannot be measured; this data gap is material because it obscures the cash available after reinvestment for servicing or repaying borrowings.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a net cash position, improving operating profitability, and robust operating cash flow, placing it comfortably within the minimal indicative financial risk profile. Leverage sits well below the sector median and liquidity is ample, so the credit story is one of balance-sheet strength rather than earnings-driven coverage.

Our forward view is that shareholder distributions absorb a large share of internally generated cash, and the absence of capex and free cash flow disclosure limits assessment of reinvestment needs. We would monitor the long-term debt maturity and any shift toward debt-funded returns, which could change the currently benign risk profile.

credit_strengths.text: 收益於三年趨勢中穩步複合增長，而經營溢利由虧損轉為溫和盈利，顯示平台正逐步邁向盈利。經營現金流於同期間增長超過一倍，證明是真正的現金產生而非會計盈利，支撐償債能力。
資產負債表具流動性且融資保守：現金超過報告債務，淨槓桿微不足道，流動比率遠高於行業中位數。利息覆蓋率雖低於行業中位數，但鑑於淨現金狀況及極低的指示性財務風險狀況，仍屬充足。

key_risks.text: 風險因素摘要指出過往虧損及未來盈利能力的不確定性，同時面對激烈競爭及快速技術變革。經營利潤率相對於行業中位數仍然偏薄，因此任何定價壓力、使用量放緩或產品轉型失敗，均可能迅速侵蝕已達致的溫和盈利，並對內部現金產生構成壓力。
債務幾乎全為長期借款，並無單獨標示的短期借款或商業票據，亦無披露到期時間表。因此再融資集中於單一子彈式還款，其時間不明，而已付現金利息是唯一可得的利息成本代理指標，限制了對該債務真實成本的能見度。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流從容覆蓋報告債務，並遠超年度已付現金利息，因此債務償付獲經常性現金產生良好支持。淨槓桿微不足道，指示性財務風險狀況極低，相對於行業中位數槓桿水平提供充裕空間。
流動性強勁，流動資產覆蓋流動負債數倍，現金超過債務。然而，資本開支並無披露，因此無法衡量自由現金流及其對債務的覆蓋；此數據缺口屬重大，因其掩蓋了再投資後可用於償付或償還借款的現金。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈現淨現金狀況、經營盈利能力改善及強勁經營現金流，使其穩處於極低指示性財務風險狀況。槓桿遠低於行業中位數，流動性充裕，因此信貸故事在於資產負債表實力而非盈利驅動的覆蓋。
我們的前瞻觀點是股東分派吸收內部產生現金的很大份額，而缺乏資本開支及自由現金流披露限制了對再投資需求的評估。我們將監察長期債務到期情況及任何轉向債務融資回報的變化，這可能改變目前良性的風險狀況。
